tables.name: pas_driver
tables.comment: Driver information for procurement and sourcing operations

tables.name: pas_driver_supplier
tables.comment: Intermediate table for driver-supplier relationship (many-to-many)

tables.name: pas_purchase_order_line_tax
tables.comment: Impuestos aplicados a cada linea de la OC. ext_code, name y rate son snapshot historico al momento de la OC

tables.name: pas_purchase_order_reception_distribution
tables.comment: Tabla intermedia que distribuye cantidades de SKUs desde la recepción consolidada a las recepciones hijas (OC múltiple)

tables.name: pas_supplier_contact
tables.comment: Contactos asociados a un proveedor, clasificados por tipo de contacto

tables.name: pas_supplier_contact_type
tables.comment: Tipos de contacto de proveedor (comercial, administrativo, logistica, etc.)

tables.name: pdd_backlog_source_allocation
tables.comment: Atribucion contable del saldo y del cumplimiento a su fuente DECAS; no asigna ni reserva stock.

tables.name: pdd_branch_stock_position
tables.comment: Foto inmutable del stock neto explicable por corrida, CD, sucursal y articulo.

tables.name: pdd_current_backlog_line
tables.comment: Proyeccion reconstruible del saldo DECAS vigente. No es una orden, reserva ni asignacion de stock.

tables.name: pdd_directed_need
tables.comment: Cabecera persistente de necesidades dirigidas E/C/A; no se recrea en cada corrida.

tables.name: pdd_dispatch_line_allocation
tables.comment: Imputacion congelada de una linea de viaje a sus fuentes DECAS en orden E vencida, E, C, D, A, S.

tables.name: pdd_dispatch_plan
tables.comment: Plan Connexa que congela una seleccion del backlog antes de crear viajes y publicar a Valkimia.

tables.name: pdd_dispatch_trip
tables.comment: Viaje o carga planificada y cubicada por Connexa; Valkimia solamente la ejecuta.

tables.name: pdd_dispatch_trip_line
tables.comment: Cantidad de una linea de backlog reservada para un viaje. Conserva UUID, version y snapshot leidos.

tables.name: pdd_dispatch_trip_stop
tables.comment: Parada del viaje en una sucursal destino; ordena la descarga y agrupa las lineas.

tables.name: pdd_distribution_scope_version
tables.comment: Version inmutable del universo distribuible desde CD 41; los conteos se calculan y nunca se hardcodean.

tables.name: pdd_execution_event
tables.comment: Evento externo append-only y deduplicado; importar por si solo no reduce el saldo.

tables.name: pdd_integration_checkpoint
tables.comment: Cursor y estado durable del polling o escritura de una interfaz legacy.

tables.name: pdd_item_logistics_snapshot
tables.comment: Snapshot inmutable de la configuracion logistica utilizada por una corrida PDD.

tables.name: pdd_need_snapshot
tables.comment: Foto inmutable de necesidades automaticas D/S. Las nuevas corridas reemplazan la foto vigente, no acumulan D/S.

tables.name: pdd_pdvb_current
tables.comment: Proyeccion vigente por CD-articulo-sucursal. Solo admite estimaciones no bloqueadas.

tables.name: pdd_pdvb_estimate
tables.comment: Historia operativa compacta de PDVB; el detalle completo permanece en diarco_data.datamart.dm_pdd_pdvb_estimate_detail.

tables.name: pdd_pdvb_publication_stage
tables.comment: Staging transaccional para publicar el subconjunto PDVB desde diarco_data sin consultar tablas pesadas por FDW.

tables.name: pdd_valkimia_batch_event
tables.comment: Espejo Connexa de dbo.CNX_PDD_EVENTO_ENVIO: acuse append-only de Valkimia a nivel LOTE. Es el unico lugar donde puede registrarse un rechazo de lote, que por definicion no tiene linea asociada.

tables.name: pdd_valkimia_dispatch
tables.comment: Espejo Connexa de dbo.CNX_PDD_DESPACHO: despacho fisico real informado por Valkimia. Es la evidencia de cumplimiento logistico y el origen del stock en transito.

tables.name: pdd_valkimia_dispatch_line
tables.comment: Espejo Connexa de dbo.CNX_PDD_DESPACHO_LINEA: cantidad efectivamente despachada por linea. Fuente de verdad del cumplimiento de la necesidad.

tables.name: pdd_valkimia_import
tables.comment: Publicacion de un viaje aprobado hacia el adaptador Valkimia; no es un borrador ni un plan editable.

tables.name: pdd_valkimia_import_line_status
tables.comment: Catalogo canonico de estados normalizados de una linea enviada a Valkimia.

tables.name: pdd_valkimia_status_mapping
tables.comment: Traduccion versionada de un estado externo del adaptador al estado normalizado del catalogo.

tables.name: pdd_vehicle_type
tables.comment: Catalogo canonico Connexa de tipos de vehiculo habilitados para planificar viajes PDD.

tables.name: spl_distribution_transfer_status
tables.comment: Catálogo de estados para las Solicitudes de Transferencia CD → Tiendas.

tables.name: spl_site_sales_data
tables.comment: Aggregated sales data per site and product used for sales-based proration calculations

tables.name: spl_stock_policy_rule
tables.comment: Politica de cobertura: local o grupo, familia, rubro opcional y clasificacion. Rubro NULL aplica a toda la familia. Sustituye conceptualmente las reglas dummy de spl_supply_cluster_category.

tables.name: spl_store_type_configuration
tables.comment: Configuration table for fixed quantities per store type used in direct purchase proration

SELECT row_number() OVER () AS id,
    b.id AS proposal_id,
    array_agg(a.id) AS supplier_product_site_ids,
    b.proposal_number,
    c.id AS supplier_id,
    c.ext_code AS ext_code_supplier,
    c.name AS name_supplier,
    d.id AS site_id,
    d.code AS ext_code_site,
    d.type AS type_site,
    d.name,
    min((a.cod_cd)::text) AS cod_cd,
    sum(a.proposed_quantity) AS proposed_quantity,
    sum(COALESCE(a.quantity_confirmed, (0)::double precision)) AS quantity_confirmed,
    sum(a.total_price) AS total_amount,
    sum(a.quantity_purchase_units) AS total_units,
    sum(a.quantity_purchase) AS total_box,
    count(DISTINCT a.product_id) AS total_product,
    sum(a.quantity_stock) AS quantity_stock,
    sum(COALESCE(a.occupation_pallet, (0)::double precision)) AS occupation_pallet,
    sum(COALESCE(a.occupation_pallet_proposed_quantity)) AS occupation_pallet_proposed,
    bool_and(COALESCE(a.approved, false)) AS approved
   FROM (((commercial_agreements.cag_supply_purchase_proposal_supplier_product_site a
     JOIN commercial_agreements.cag_supply_purchase_proposal b ON ((a.supply_purchase_proposal_id = b.id)))
     JOIN commercial_agreements.cag_supplier c ON ((b.supplier_id = c.id)))
     JOIN commercial_agreements.cag_site d ON ((a.site_id = d.id)))
  GROUP BY b.id, b.proposal_number, c.id, d.id, d.code, d.type, d.name;

SELECT COALESCE(((blockingl.relation)::regclass)::text, blockingl.locktype) AS locked_item,
    (now() - blockeda.query_start) AS waiting_duration,
    blockeda.pid AS blocked_pid,
    blockeda.query AS blocked_query,
    blockedl.mode AS blocked_mode,
    blockinga.pid AS blocking_pid,
    blockinga.query AS blocking_query,
    blockingl.mode AS blocking_mode
   FROM (((pg_locks blockedl
     JOIN pg_stat_activity blockeda ON ((blockedl.pid = blockeda.pid)))
     JOIN pg_locks blockingl ON ((((blockingl.transactionid = blockedl.transactionid) OR ((blockingl.relation = blockedl.relation) AND (blockingl.locktype = blockedl.locktype))) AND (blockedl.pid <> blockingl.pid))))
     JOIN pg_stat_activity blockinga ON (((blockingl.pid = blockinga.pid) AND (blockinga.datid = blockeda.datid))))
  WHERE ((NOT blockedl.granted) AND (blockinga.datname = current_database()));

SELECT fnd_product.sku AS itemid,
    fnd_product.description AS itemname,
    fnd_stock.quantity AS stock,
    fnd_site.code AS storeid,
    fnd_site.name AS storename,
    fnd_product.status_id
   FROM fnd_stock,
    fnd_site,
    fnd_product
  WHERE ((fnd_stock.site_id = fnd_site.id) AND (fnd_stock.product_id = fnd_product.id));

SELECT fnd_product.sku AS itemid,
    fnd_product.description AS itemname,
    fnd_stock.quantity AS stock,
    fnd_site.code AS storeid,
    fnd_site.name AS storename,
    fnd_product.status_id
   FROM fnd_stock,
    fnd_site,

  WHERE ((fnd_stock.site_id = fnd_site.id) AND (fnd_stock.product_id = fnd_product.id) AND (fnd_product.status_id = 1));

SELECT concat(b.proposal_number, '-', c.ext_code) AS id,
    b.id AS proposal_id,
    b.proposal_number,
    b.status AS proposal_status,
    b.buyer_id AS buyer,
    c.id AS supplier_id,
    c.ext_code AS ext_code_supplier,
    c.name AS name_supplier,
    sum(a.proposed_quantity) AS proposed_quantity,
    sum(COALESCE(a.quantity_confirmed, (0)::double precision)) AS quantity_confirmed,
    sum(a.total_price) AS total_amount,
    sum(a.quantity_purchase_units) AS total_units,
    sum(a.quantity_purchase) AS total_box,
    count(DISTINCT a.product_id) AS total_products,
    count(DISTINCT a.site_id) AS total_sites,
    sum(COALESCE(a.occupation_pallet, (0)::double precision)) AS occupation_pallet,
    sum(COALESCE(a.occupation_pallet_proposed_quantity)) AS occupation_pallet_proposed,
    bool_and(COALESCE(a.approved, false)) AS approved,
    count(DISTINCT
        CASE
            WHEN (d.approved = true) THEN d.product_id
            ELSE NULL::uuid
        END) AS number_approved
   FROM spl_supply_purchase_proposal_supplier_product_site a,
    spl_supply_purchase_proposal b,
    fnd_supplier c,
    view_spl_supply_purchase_proposal_supplier_product d
  WHERE ((a.supply_purchase_proposal_id = b.id) AND (b.supplier_id = c.id) AND (d.proposal_id = b.id) AND (d.product_id = a.product_id))
  GROUP BY b.proposal_number, c.ext_code, b.id, b.status, b.buyer_id, c.id, c.name;

SELECT concat(b.proposal_number, '-', d.ext_code) AS id,
    b.id AS proposal_id,
    b.proposal_number,
    c.id AS supplier_id,
    c.ext_code AS ext_code_supplier,
    c.name AS name_supplier,
    d.id AS product_id,
    d.ext_code AS ext_code_product,
    d.description AS description_product,
    COALESCE(d.image, ''::character varying) AS path_image_product,
    e.ext_code AS ext_code_status,
    e.name AS name_status,
    sum(a.proposed_quantity) AS proposed_quantity,
    sum(COALESCE(a.quantity_confirmed, (0)::double precision)) AS quantity_confirmed,
    sum(a.total_price) AS total_amount,
    sum(a.quantity_purchase_units) AS total_units,
    sum(a.quantity_purchase) AS total_box,
    count(DISTINCT a.site_id) AS total_sites,
    sum(a.quantity_stock) AS quantity_stock,
    sum(COALESCE(a.occupation_pallet, (0)::double precision)) AS occupation_pallet,
    sum(COALESCE(a.occupation_pallet_proposed_quantity)) AS occupation_pallet_proposed,
    bool_and(COALESCE(a.approved, false)) AS approved
   FROM spl_supply_purchase_proposal_supplier_product_site a,
    spl_supply_purchase_proposal b,
    fnd_supplier c,
    fnd_product d,
    fnd_product_status e
  WHERE ((a.supply_purchase_proposal_id = b.id) AND (b.supplier_id = c.id) AND (a.product_id = d.id) AND (d.status_id = e.id))
  GROUP BY b.proposal_number, d.ext_code, b.id, c.id, c.ext_code, c.name, d.id, d.description, d.image, e.ext_code, e.name;

SELECT concat(a.ext_product_code, '-', a.ext_supplier_code) AS id,
    a.supply_forecast_execution_execute_id,

    c.ext_code AS ext_code_status,

    sum(COALESCE(a.quantity_confirmed, (0)::double precision)) AS quantity_confirmed,

   FROM supply_planning.spl_supply_forecast_execution_execute_result a,

  WHERE ((a.product_id = b.id) AND (b.status_id = c.id))
  GROUP BY (concat(a.ext_product_code, '-', a.ext_supplier_code)), a.supply_forecast_execution_execute_id, a.ext_product_code, b.description, b.image, c.ext_code, c.name;

SELECT b.backlog_line_id,
    b.backlog_line_uuid,
    b.row_version,
    b.snapshot_version,
    b.calculation_run_id,
    b.origin_cd,
    b.sucursal,
    b.codigo_articulo,
    b.c_proveedor_primario,
    b.product_id,
    b.site_id,
    b.supplier_id,
    b.origin_site_id,
    b.product_description,
    b.site_name,
    b.supplier_name,
    b.available_to_plan_quantity,
    b.cd_reference_stock,
        CASE
            WHEN (b.cd_reference_stock IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE GREATEST((b.cd_reference_stock - COALESCE(act.total_activo, (0)::numeric)), (0)::numeric)
        END AS real_available_quantity,
    b.mandatory_open_quantity,
    b.optional_open_quantity,
    b.total_open_quantity,
    b.estimated_packages,
    b.estimated_pallets,
    b.estimated_weight_kg,
    b.estimated_volume_m3,
    b.irq_score,
    b.priority_score,
    b.target_date,
    b.oldest_need_date,
    b.freshness_status
   FROM (stock_management.vw_backlog_real_base b
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.codigo_articulo,
            sum(o.planned_quantity) AS total_activo
           FROM stock_management.pdd_dispatch_trip_line o
          WHERE ((o.status)::text = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::text, 'RESERVED'::text, 'PUBLISH_PENDING'::text, 'PUBLISHED'::text, 'ACCEPTED'::text, 'PARTIAL'::text, 'PREPARED'::text, 'DISPATCHED'::text]))
          GROUP BY o.codigo_articulo) act ON ((act.codigo_articulo = b.codigo_articulo)))
  WHERE ((b.available_to_plan_quantity > (0)::numeric) AND ((b.freshness_status)::text = 'CURRENT'::text) AND ((b.cd_reference_stock IS NULL) OR (b.cd_reference_stock > (0)::numeric)) AND (NOT (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
           FROM stock_management.pdd_dispatch_trip_line dtl
          WHERE ((dtl.backlog_line_uuid = b.backlog_line_uuid) AND ((dtl.status)::text = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::text, 'RESERVED'::text, 'PUBLISH_PENDING'::text, 'PUBLISHED'::text, 'ACCEPTED'::text, 'PARTIAL'::text, 'PREPARED'::text, 'DISPATCHED'::text])))))));

SELECT dtl.dispatch_trip_line_id,
    dtl.dispatch_trip_id,
    dtl.dispatch_trip_stop_id,
    dtl.backlog_line_uuid,
    dtl.planned_quantity,
    dtl.status,
    dtl.codigo_articulo,
    dtl.sucursal,
    dtl.c_proveedor_primario,
    dtl.uom,
    dtl.estimated_packages,
    dtl.estimated_pallets,
    dtl.estimated_weight_kg,
    dtl.estimated_volume_m3,
    dtl.irq_score,
    dtl.priority_score,
    b.product_description,
    b.site_name AS site_label,
    b.supplier_name,
    b.available_to_plan_quantity,
    b.cd_reference_stock,
    b.cd_reference_stock AS real_available_quantity,
    b.mandatory_open_quantity,
    b.optional_open_quantity,
    b.total_open_quantity,
    ils.units_per_package AS units_per_box,
    ils.units_per_pallet,
        CASE
            WHEN (b.cd_reference_stock IS NULL) THEN NULL::numeric
            ELSE GREATEST(((b.cd_reference_stock - (sum(dtl.planned_quantity) OVER (PARTITION BY dtl.dispatch_trip_id, dtl.codigo_articulo) - dtl.planned_quantity)) - (COALESCE(act.total_activo, (0)::numeric) - COALESCE(sum(dtl.planned_quantity) FILTER (WHERE ((dtl.status)::text = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::text, 'RESERVED'::text, 'PUBLISH_PENDING'::text, 'PUBLISHED'::text, 'ACCEPTED'::text, 'PARTIAL'::text, 'PREPARED'::text, 'DISPATCHED'::text]))) OVER (PARTITION BY dtl.dispatch_trip_id, dtl.codigo_articulo), (0)::numeric))), (0)::numeric)
        END AS max_allowed_quantity
   FROM (((stock_management.pdd_dispatch_trip_line dtl
     LEFT JOIN stock_management.vw_backlog_real_base b ON ((b.backlog_line_uuid = dtl.backlog_line_uuid)))
     LEFT JOIN stock_management.pdd_item_logistics_snapshot ils ON (((ils.calculation_run_id = b.calculation_run_id) AND (ils.origin_cd = b.origin_cd) AND (ils.codigo_articulo = b.codigo_articulo))))
     LEFT JOIN ( SELECT o.codigo_articulo,
            sum(o.planned_quantity) AS total_activo
           FROM stock_management.pdd_dispatch_trip_line o
          WHERE ((o.status)::text = ANY (ARRAY['DRAFT'::text, 'RESERVED'::text, 'PUBLISH_PENDING'::text, 'PUBLISHED'::text, 'ACCEPTED'::text, 'PARTIAL'::text, 'PREPARED'::text, 'DISPATCHED'::text]))
          GROUP BY o.codigo_articulo) act ON ((act.codigo_articulo = dtl.codigo_articulo)));

SELECT bl.sucursal AS branch_id,

    bl.e_open_quantity AS e_quantity,

   FROM ((stock_management.pdd_current_backlog_line bl

     LEFT JOIN stock_management.pdd_cd_stock_position csp ON (((bl.origin_cd = csp.origin_cd) AND (bl.codigo_articulo = csp.codigo_articulo) AND (bl.business_date = csp.business_date))))
  WHERE ((bl.freshness_status)::text = 'CURRENT'::text);

WITH RECURSIVE category_path AS (
         SELECT c.id,
            c.ext_code,
            c.name,
            c.parent_id,
            c.id AS leaf_id,
            c.ext_code AS leaf_ext_code,
            c.name AS leaf_name,

            cp.leaf_ext_code,

            cp.leaf_parent_id,
            (((c2.name)::text || ' - '::text) || (cp.path)::text)
           FROM (supply_planning.spl_category c2
             JOIN category_path cp ON ((c2.id = cp.parent_id)))
        )
 SELECT category_path.leaf_id AS id,
    category_path.leaf_ext_code AS ext_code,

   FROM category_path

WITH stock_agg AS (
         SELECT lbs.codigo_articulo,
            sum(lbs.stock) AS total_stock,
            count(DISTINCT lbs.codigo_sucursal) AS total_sites
           FROM supply_planning.local_base_stock_site_view lbs
          WHERE (lbs.precio_venta IS NOT NULL)
          GROUP BY lbs.codigo_articulo
        )
 SELECT row_number() OVER () AS id,
    abp.id AS agile_purchase_id,
    array_agg(sps.id) AS supplier_product_site_ids,
    abp.name AS agile_purchase_name,
    sup.id AS supplier_id,
    sup.ext_code AS ext_code_supplier,
    sup.name AS name_supplier,
    art.clasificacion,
    prod.id AS product_id,
    prod.ext_code AS ext_code_product,
    prod.description AS description_product,
    ps.ext_code AS ext_code_status,
    ps.name AS name_status,
    sum(sps.requested_units) AS requested_units,
    sum(COALESCE(sps.quantity_confirmed, (0)::double precision)) AS quantity_confirmed,
    sum(COALESCE(sps.total_price, (0)::double precision)) AS total_amount,
    sum(COALESCE(sps.purchased_units, (0)::double precision)) AS total_units,
    count(DISTINCT sps.site_id) AS total_sites,
    sum(COALESCE(sps.stock, (0)::double precision)) AS quantity_stock,
    sum(COALESCE(sps.occupation_pallet, (0)::double precision)) AS occupation_pallet,
    bool_and(COALESCE(sps.approved, false)) AS approved,
    COALESCE(sa.total_stock, (0)::double precision) AS stock_total_aggregated,
    COALESCE(sa.total_sites, (0)::bigint) AS stock_sites_aggregated
   FROM ((((((supply_planning.spl_agile_buyer_purchase_supplier_product_site sps
     JOIN supply_planning.spl_agile_buyer_purchase abp ON ((sps.agile_purchase_id = abp.id)))
     JOIN supply_planning.spl_supplier sup ON ((abp.supplier_id = sup.id)))
     JOIN supply_planning.spl_product prod ON ((sps.product_id = prod.id)))
     JOIN supply_planning.spl_product_status ps ON ((prod.status_id = ps.id)))
     LEFT JOIN supply_planning.local_m_3_articulos_view art ON (((art.c_articulo)::text = (sps.product_code)::text)))
     LEFT JOIN stock_agg sa ON (((sa.codigo_articulo)::text = (sps.product_code)::text)))
  GROUP BY abp.id, abp.name, sup.id, sup.ext_code, sup.name, art.clasificacion, prod.id, prod.ext_code, prod.description, prod.image, ps.ext_code, ps.name, sa.total_stock, sa.total_sites;

WITH stock_agg AS (

 SELECT row_number() OVER () AS id,

    array_agg(sps.id) AS supplier_product_site_ids,
    abp.name AS agile_purchase_name,
    sup.id AS supplier_id,
    sup.ext_code AS ext_code_supplier,
    sup.name AS name_supplier,
    s.id AS site_id,
    s.code AS ext_code_site,
    s.type AS type_site,
    s.name AS name_site,
    sum(sps.requested_units) AS requested_units,
    sum(COALESCE(sps.quantity_confirmed, (0)::double precision)) AS quantity_confirmed,
    sum(COALESCE(sps.total_price, (0)::double precision)) AS total_amount,
    sum(COALESCE(sps.purchased_units, (0)::double precision)) AS total_units,
    count(DISTINCT sps.product_id) AS total_product,
    sum(COALESCE(sps.stock, (0)::double precision)) AS quantity_stock,
    sum(COALESCE(sps.occupation_pallet, (0)::double precision)) AS occupation_pallet,

SELECT (b.id)::text AS id,
    b.id AS proposal_id,
    b.proposal_number,
    b.status AS proposal_status,
    b.buyer_id AS buyer,
    c.id AS supplier_id,
    c.ext_code AS ext_code_supplier,
    c.name AS name_supplier,
    sum(a.proposed_quantity) AS proposed_quantity,
    sum(COALESCE(a.quantity_confirmed, (0)::double precision)) AS quantity_confirmed,
    sum(a.total_price) AS total_amount,
    sum(a.quantity_purchase_units) AS total_units,
    sum(a.quantity_purchase) AS total_box,
    count(DISTINCT a.product_id) AS total_products,
    count(DISTINCT a.site_id) AS total_sites,
    sum(COALESCE(a.occupation_pallet, (0)::double precision)) AS occupation_pallet,

        CASE
            WHEN (d.approved = true) THEN d.product_id

   FROM supply_planning.spl_supply_purchase_proposal_supplier_product_site a,

  GROUP BY b.proposal_number, c.ext_code, b.id, b.status, b.buyer_id, c.id, c.name;

SELECT (((((b.id)::text || ':'::text) || (c.id)::text) || ':'::text) || (d.id)::text) AS id,
    b.id AS proposal_id,
    array_agg(a.id) AS supplier_product_site_ids,
    b.proposal_number,
    c.id AS supplier_id,
    c.ext_code AS ext_code_supplier,
    c.name AS name_supplier,
    d.id AS product_id,
    d.ext_code AS ext_code_product,
    d.description AS description_product,
    COALESCE(d.image, ''::character varying) AS path_image_product,
    e.ext_code AS ext_code_status,
    e.name AS name_status,
    min((a.cod_cd)::text) AS cod_cd,
    sum(a.proposed_quantity) AS proposed_quantity,
    sum(COALESCE(a.quantity_confirmed, (0)::double precision)) AS quantity_confirmed,
    sum(a.total_price) AS total_amount,
    sum(a.quantity_purchase_units) AS total_units,

    count(DISTINCT a.site_id) AS total_sites,

    sum(COALESCE(a.occupation_pallet, (0)::double precision)) AS occupation_pallet,
    sum(COALESCE(a.occupation_pallet_proposed_quantity, (0)::double precision)) AS occupation_pallet_proposed,
    bool_and(COALESCE(a.approved, false)) AS approved
   FROM ((((supply_planning.spl_supply_purchase_proposal_supplier_product_site a
     JOIN supply_planning.spl_supply_purchase_proposal b ON ((a.supply_purchase_proposal_id = b.id)))
     JOIN supply_planning.spl_supplier c ON ((b.supplier_id = c.id)))
     JOIN supply_planning.spl_product d ON ((a.product_id = d.id)))
     JOIN supply_planning.spl_product_status e ON ((d.status_id = e.id)))
  GROUP BY b.proposal_number, b.id, c.id, c.ext_code, c.name, d.id, d.ext_code, d.description, d.image, e.ext_code, e.name;

SELECT (((((b.id)::text || ':'::text) || (d.id)::text) || ':'::text) || c.id) AS id,
    b.id AS proposal_id,
    array_agg(a.id) AS supplier_product_site_ids,
    b.proposal_number,
    c.id AS supplier_id,
    c.ext_code AS ext_code_supplier,
    c.name AS name_supplier,
    d.id AS site_id,

    sum(a.quantity_purchase_units) AS total_units,
    sum(a.quantity_purchase) AS total_box,
    count(DISTINCT a.product_id) AS total_product,
    sum(a.quantity_stock) AS quantity_stock,
    sum(COALESCE(a.occupation_pallet, (0)::double precision)) AS occupation_pallet,
    sum(COALESCE(a.occupation_pallet_proposed_quantity)) AS occupation_pallet_proposed,
    bool_and(COALESCE(a.approved, false)) AS approved
   FROM (((supply_planning.spl_supply_purchase_proposal_supplier_product_site a
     JOIN supply_planning.spl_supply_purchase_proposal b ON ((a.supply_purchase_proposal_id = b.id)))

     JOIN supply_planning.spl_site d ON ((a.site_id = d.id)))
  GROUP BY b.id, b.proposal_number, c.id, d.id, d.code, d.type, d.name;

SELECT concat(a.ext_product_code, '-', a.ext_supplier_code) AS id,
    a.supply_forecast_execution_execute_id,
    a.ext_product_code,
    b.description,
    b.image AS path_image_product,
    c.ext_code AS ext_code_status,

    sum(a.quantity_stock) AS quantity_stock,

SELECT (((((((p.purchase_order_number)::text || '-'::text) || (COALESCE(ps.product_sku, ''::character varying))::text) || '-'::text) || (COALESCE(ps.site_code, ''::character varying))::text) || '-'::text) || row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY p.purchase_order_number, ps.product_sku, ps.site_code ORDER BY p.purchase_order_create_date)) AS id,

    ps.last_28_days_sale_site,
        CASE

     LEFT JOIN supply_planning.spl_purchase_order_product_site_workflow ps ON (((ps.purchase_order_number = p.purchase_order_number) AND ((ps.product_sku)::text = (pw.product_sku)::text))));
